upgrade_scenarios: Two copies, costs, wish and printing image survive a new disputed hold

Evidence can be supplied to the held printing picture without confirming it
Explicit promotion uses the same physical ID
Legacy metadata/physical confirmations take precedence over a new catalog hold

limits: Software checks do not establish factual accuracy or inventory completeness.
